name: Grand Pskov Story
source:
This is a difficult story that could happen to each of us:

A young man named Batruha acquired a serious psychological illness. To heal, he needs to go to group therapy to Dr. X, who conducts experimental courses, putting the wards into trance. There, Dr. X with the help of a friend Jesas is trying his best to help his patients.
Falling under the influence of Dr. H's hypnosis, Batrukh talks about his new lover, Dunka Kulakova from St. Petersburg, about her secular manners and extreme courtesy.

The doctor, considering all the features of this patient, begins his session. But how can all this end for Batruhi? And how will this affect the fate of Dr. X himself?

All the favorite story about the two ends and three pockets played with new colors and unexpected plot twists.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201028015923/http://store.steampowered.com/app/735590/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个可能发生在我们每个人身上的艰难故事：

一个名叫巴特鲁哈的年轻人患上了严重的心理疾病。为了治愈，他必须参加X医生主持的团体治疗。X医生开展实验性课程，让患者进入催眠状态，并与朋友耶萨一起尽力帮助他们。

在H医生的催眠影响下，巴特鲁赫谈起了自己的新恋人、来自圣彼得堡的邓卡·库拉科娃，以及她世故的举止和极端的礼貌。

医生考虑到患者的所有特征，开始了治疗。但这一切最终会如何影响巴特鲁赫？又会如何改变X医生自己的命运？

这个关于两端三袋的熟悉故事，将以全新色彩和意外剧情转折再次上演。

[来源：[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201028015923/http://store.steampowered.com/app/735590/]Steam[/url]]
